subject: Incident triage, reporting SLA, and evidence bundle
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@finsecure.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finsecure.com
Date: 2026-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: evidence & SLAs for misuse detection and reporting

Priyom,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our internal procurement and SOC review we need a consolidated response covering Redwood's operational controls for content safety and abuse prevention. Specifically we need: 

- A short evidence bundle (artifacts we can provide to auditors) that demonstrates monitoring and alerting for misuse.
- The incident triage and escalation SLAs (ack/triage/mitigation windows) by priority class.
- Description of what logs/audit trails you retain (request metadata, model version, prompt/response hashes) and retention periods.
- How automated policy enforcement and manual review interplay (what's auto-blocked vs flagged, escalation gates).
- A point of contact for any live escalation during evaluation.

Can you send the above plus any attachments by EOD tomorrow (Wed Aug 26)? Procurment and our security reviewers are on a tight timeline.

Appreciate it — Elaine

Elaine Park
Security Operations Manager, FinSecure
elaine.park@finsecure.com
+1 415-555-0192

--

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@finsecure.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-25T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence & SLAs for misuse detection and reporting

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a concise evidence bundle and the operational runbook. Summary below; full artifacts attached and in the shared drive link.

High-level summary (TL;DR):
- Evidence bundle: redwood_misuse_monitoring_matrix.xlsx (detection rule catalog + test vectors), incident_escalation_matrix.pdf (roles/responsibilities + notification flows), slo_reporting_runbook.md (how to reproduce alert exports and audit snapshots).
- SLAs (target windows):
  * P0 (active abuse causing data exfil / regulatory exposure): 5m alerting, 15m ack, 1h mitigation plan (automated + human follow-up)
  * P1 (high-confidence misuse patterns / legal-risk): 15m alerting, 1h ack, 4h triage/containment
  * P2 (medium confidence / suspicious activity): 1h alerting, 4h ack, 24h triage
  * P3 (low priority / informational): daily batching for review
- Logs retained: per-request audit entries (timestamp, model id, model hash, request metadata, response metadata, safety-classification result), anonymized prompt hash with reversible token index for forensic replay if subpoenaed. Default retention: 90 days; can be extended under enterprise contract.
- Automated enforcement vs manual review: policy rules run in a layered pipeline — first a fast, deterministic filter (auto-block / auto-rate-limit), second a scoring model for misuse patterns (flagged for human review above threshold), third a queued human moderation escalation when the confidence and potential impact cross pre-defined gates. The escalation matrix maps to legal/compliance notification thresholds (see attached matrix).

Operational contacts:
- Primary: priyom.das@redwood.ai (me) — will be first responder and liaison.
- Escalations / CS: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
- Applied ML (detection model lead): rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Links: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/finsecure-evidence-bundle (read-only)
CRM record: https://crm.redwood.ai/hubspot/contacts/FS-2026-08-01

Note on evidence: the bundle includes sample alert exports and a truncated audit log example (PII redacted). If your auditors need raw logs we can coordinate a secure transfer under NDA.

I'll follow up tomorrow with one-page diagrams for the escalation path and confirmation of retention windows on the Dedicated instance you're evaluating.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 628-555-0123

--
Attachments: redwood_misuse_monitoring_matrix.xlsx; incident_escalation_matrix.pdf; slo_reporting_runbook.md

Looping in a couple quick clarifications from CS and Legal so we can provide precisely what your auditors want.

Priyom — thanks for the bundle. Two asks from FinSecure's checklist that we didn't see explicitly in the attachments:
- Does the escalation matrix include automated notification to FinSecure legal/compliance (email/pager) for any P0 or P1 event? If not, we should document the exact triggers and delivery channels.
- Can you export a sample "evidence packet" that contains the full chain (alert, relevant request traces, model version, and redaction log) so FinSecure can validate the auditability? A one-click export runbook is ideal.

Elaine — can we book a short 30-min call tomorrow morning to walk through the matrix and confirm the packet format? If you prefer, we'll prepare the additional packet proactively and upload to the shared drive.

Thanks — Marissa
